CustomField.description: Indicates whether this investor Contact has self-attested or been verified as an accredited investor per SEC Regulation D. Mirrors Lead.Is_Accredited__c and receives its value from the Lead on conversion via InvestorLeadConvertService — no user action is required to populate it directly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check if this investor has confirmed accredited investor status.
CustomField.label: Is Accredited
